<objective>
The shared standards for one Outcome Engineering Change record at its declared maturity.
</objective>

<reference_note>

Read `${SKILL_DIR}/references/change-record.md` completely before applying these standards.
The reference owns the record rules; authoring and auditing procedures remain in their respective skills.

</reference_note>

<success_criteria>

- Each record requirement has one canonical statement in the shared reference.
- Maturity, Lifecycle, product truth, and continuation have distinct meanings.
- Every requirement can be judged against the Change, its declared relationships, and necessary repository references.

</success_criteria>
